page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan. Left page: running text in one column, page number 314 and running head "NO" at the top. Right page: a narrow column of marginal notes in the right margin (partly cut off by the binding and the page edge), set in small type, crowded and partly illegible. Nothing printed below the text on the left page apart from the catchword-free end of the entries.

main_text.p: μλω στο & Attice ε ψλὰ initiali abjecto legesacceperam.
Νόμισμα ως το numifma fcil. nummus legitimus, cujus usus & valor νενόμισμαι h.e. lege sancitus est.
Νοσέω ὤ ægroto per metaphoricam fynecdochen infanio 1.Tim.6.4. F.νόσω.P.νενοσηκέ.
Νοσσιὰ ὰς ἡ pullities per syncopen ἕ ε ψιλὰ pro νεοσσιὰ, à Th. νεοσσὸς vel Attice νεοσσὸς ὁ pullus, tenera & recens à partu avicula, Deut.22.6.
Νοσσίον ὁ τὸ pullulus, pullus recens, diminutivum, à νεοσσὸς ἕ ὁ per syncopen, pro νεοσσὸς ὁ pullus. unde est νεοσσίον τὸ pullulus Psal. 84.3. Quaedam exemplaria habent νεοσσίον τὸ sed vitiose.
Νοσφίζομαι interverto, furripio. (ab adv.νόσφι seorsum, sine.) F.ἱσομαι. a.1.med. ἐνοσφισάμην ὦ ἀφ. a.1.med.infin.νοσφίσασθαι.
Νότος ὁ auster, nomen venti a meridie spirantis. regio auftralis. videtur haec vox orta a nomine νοτὶς ἰδ ἡ humiditas, vel contra.
Νεμεσῶ ας ἡ q.amissa mentis repositio, admonitio. ex νόω ὡς ὁ mens & θέσις εως ἡ positio.
Νεμετῶ ὤ admoneo, commonefacio. Fut. ήσω. P.ενεμετήμην. a.1.act.ἐνεμετήσα. praf.pass.νεμε-τῶμαι ἐμαι admoneor.

page.notes: The right-hand marginal column is very damaged and cut off at the page edge; its entries (Greek and Latin cross-references and short glosses) are largely illegible and are not transcribed. Greek forms on the left page are read with some uncertainty, especially accents and breathings.
